title: Incorrect condition for disabling progress
detail: The condition `if not self.disable` is inverted. It should be `if self.disable` to skip the logic when the progress is disabled, but the current implementation will execute the logic when `self.disable` is `False`.
note: about self.disable, not the planted or

title: Incorrect condition for printing on non-interactive consoles
detail: The condition `if not self.console.is_interactive or not self.console.is_jupyter` will trigger the `self.console.print()` call when either `is_interactive` is `False` or `is_jupyter` is `False`. This may not be the intended behavior, as it could print on interactive consoles if `is_jupyter` is `False`.
note: the or prints on interactive consoles

title: Incorrect logic in accept_html
detail: The line returns True if "text/html" is not in self, which is the opposite of the intended behavior. The property should return True if "text/html" is accepted, not if it is not present.
note: returns True when text/html is not accepted
